notes.title: Dark Laws Playtest V1.0.2
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We’re back with another update to the Dark Laws Playtest! Thanks again for all the incredible feedback—it’s been amazing seeing how you explore Telos Island and push the game to its limits. This patch focuses on stability and visuals to make your playtest experience smoother and more immersive.[/p][h3]Here’s what’s new:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Multiplayer (Temporarily Disabled):[/b] While testing, we discovered a few audio bugs in co-op that could cause issues for all players. To keep the experience stable, we’ve temporarily disabled multiplayer until these are resolved. Don’t worry—it’ll be back, stronger and smoother![/p][/*][*][p][b]Upscaling Update:[/b] We’ve upgraded the game to x1.2 resolution upscaling, along with improved lighting. Environments and details should now look sharper and more atmospheric than ever before.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Collision Bug Fixes:[/b] Several collision issues that caused unexpected movement and lag have been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Quick Controls Recap[/h3][list][*][p][b]WASD[/b] – Move[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shift[/b] – Run[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ctrl[/b] – Crouch[/p][/*][*][p][b]Left Mouse Button[/b] – Melee Light Attack (hold to chain combo)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Right Mouse Button[/b] – Heavy Attack[/p][/*][*][p][b]F[/b] – Shield[/p][/*][*][p][b]Q[/b] – Magic[/p][/*][*][p][b]X[/b] – Roll[/p][/*][*][p][b]Space[/b] – Jump[/p][/*][*][p][b]E[/b] – Pick Up Loot / Use Linked or Extraction Portal[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tab[/b] – Inventory (drag & drop items)[/p][/*][*][p][b]H[/b] – Call Dragon (Dragon Horn)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Alt+F4[/b] – Exit Game[/p][/*][/list][h3]A Quick Reminder[/h3][p]This is still an early playtest, so expect some quirks. Your feedback is what helps us refine Dark Laws, so please keep sharing your experiences with us on [b]Discord[/b].[/p][p]We’re excited for you to explore Telos Island with upgraded visuals and smoother gameplay, and we’ll keep working hard to bring multiplayer back as soon as possible. Thanks for sticking with us on this journey—we couldn’t do it without you![/p][p]— The GVA Game Studio Team[/p]

notes.title: Dark Laws Playtest v1.0.1
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We’re excited to share the latest updates on [b]Dark Laws Playtest[/b] after some fantastic player feedback! This playtest patch introduces major new features that make exploring [b]Telos Island[/b] even more fun and accessible.[/p][p][b]Here’s what’s new:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Loading Screens:[/b] Mostly visual improvements to make transitions between menus and game loading more understandable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual Bug Fixes:[/b] Several visual issues have been resolved for a cleaner experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Extraction Portals:[/b] These portals let you safely save your inventory before exiting the game, so the next time you join, you’ll still have your items.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Simplified Multiplayer (Host / Clients):[/b] You can now explore Telos Island with friends! Multiplayer is simplified, with one host and any connected clients—perfect for co-op exploration.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Respawns:[/b] The game loop now allows respawns instead of permadeath, this will be a playtest exclusive feature.[/p][/*][/list][p]As always, you can roam freely, collect loot, experiment with abilities, and maybe even discover new areas.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Quick Controls Recap:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]WASD[/b] – Move[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shift[/b] – Run[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ctrl[/b] – Crouch[/p][/*][*][p][b]Left Mouse Button[/b] – Melee Light Attack (if held causes combo chain)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Right Mouse Button[/b] – Heavy Attack[/p][/*][*][p][b]F[/b] – Shield[/p][/*][*][p][b]Q[/b] – Magic[/p][/*][*][p][b]X[/b] - Roll[/p][/*][*][p][b]Space[/b] - Jump[/p][/*][*][p][b]E[/b] – Pick Up Loot / Use Linked or Extraction Portal[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tab[/b] – Inventory (drag and drop items)[/p][/*][*][p][b]H[/b] – Call Dragon (Dragon Horn)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Alt+F4[/b] – Exit Game[/p][/*][/list][p]This is still an early playtest, so expect some bugs and quirks. Your feedback is invaluable in helping us shape the full game.[/p][p]We can’t wait to hear your thoughts on [b]Discord[/b], see your discoveries on Telos Island, and continue building this community together. Your support and enthusiasm keep us going, and we’re thrilled to share this next stage of [b]Dark Laws[/b] with you![/p][p][/p][p]— The GVA Game Studio Team[/p]

notes.title: Dark Laws Playtest
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to finally share a first glimpse of our game with you! After years of long nights, countless iterations, and endless cups of coffee, we’re releasing a chill playtest of Dark Laws on Steam. This isn’t the full game, but it’s a chance for you to explore, experiment, and get a feel for the world we’ve been building.[/p][p][/p][p]In this playtest, you’ll wander around Telos Island, a place filled with mysterious loot, weapons, and spells with one of 9 heroes. You can pick up loot, test out your abilities, and just enjoy the game at your own pace—no enemies, no pressure, just exploration.[/p][p][/p][p]Keep your eyes open while exploring… you might stumble across a Dragon Horn, a legendary artifact that lets you soar through the skies atop a mighty dragon.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s a quick rundown of the controls:[/p][p]WASD – Move around[/p][p]Shift – Run[/p][p]Ctrl - Crouch [/p][p]Left Mouse Button – Melee light attack[/p][p]Right Mouse Button – Heavy attack[/p][p]F – Shield[/p][p]Q – Magic[/p][p]X - Roll[/p][p]Space - Jump[/p][p]E - Pick Up Loot / Use Portal [/p][p]Tab – Open inventory (drag and drop items for selection and removing from inventory)[/p][p]H - Call Dragon with the dragon horn (point to a clean area on the ground)[/p][p]Alt+F4 - Exit Game[/p][p][/p][p]We also want to be upfront: this is an early playtest, so some things might not work perfectly. Expect a few bugs or quirks—that’s all part of the testing and learning process.[/p][p][/p][p]The idea was to create a sandbox feel, where you can play around with combat, loot, and magic, and really get a sense of how the full game might play. Think of it as a place to wander, experiment, and have fun without worrying about scores or rankings.[/p][p][/p][p]A little about our journey:[/p][p]Dark Laws has been a labor of love for the last 4 years. From the very beginning, our goal was to build a world that feels alive, full of exploration, and rewarding to engage with. Along the way, we’ve faced challenges, learned a ton, and grown as a team. This playtest is a milestone—not the finish line—but we hope it gives you a taste of what’s to come.[/p][p][/p][p]We can’t wait to hear your feedback on Discord, see what you discover on Telos Island, and start building this community together. Your support, ideas, and enthusiasm mean the world to us, and we’re thrilled to finally share this part of the adventure with you.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy it![/p][p][/p][p]— The GVA Game Studio Team[/p]
